correctness.rationale: The explicit scalar Chebyshev two-cycle has \(u=(\sqrt5-1)/4\) and \(v=-(\sqrt5+1)/4\), with \(f(u)=v\), \(f(v)=u\) and \(f'(u)f'(v)=-4\). Neighboring states already equal the local images, producing the exact checkerboard travelling two-cycle for every a. Each complete two-step Jacobian decomposes on an even ring into N/2 two-sublattice Fourier blocks; at frequency k the eigenvalues are \(a^2\cos^2 k-4(1-a)^2\pm 4ia(1-a)\cos k\), whose moduli equal \(a^2\cos^2 k+4(1-a)^2\). The k=0 block is present, giving the exact all-N Floquet spectral radius \(4(1-a)^2+a^2\), and \((a-1)(5a-3)\) determines the strict stability interval. A strictly convex polynomial has its unique minimum 4/5 at \(a=4/5\). The full Jacobians and block identities were replayed in 997 finite Python standard-library diagnostics. The proof, rather than tests, establishes all real parameters and ring sizes. In the infinite l2 perturbation space the Bloch direct integral yields the same spectral radius, and the quadratic remainder is locally differentiable. Endpoints are explicitly withheld from nonlinear classification.

originality.rationale: The motivating 2026 Lippolis paper explicitly limits its derived period-two stability analysis to spatial synchrony, where the real two-cycle ends by \(a=1/3\). The new two-colour wave is spatially non-uniform, persists at strong coupling, and has an explicitly computed universal Floquet law and optimal coupling. Dettmann–Lippolis (2005) addresses the same 2B+ coupling convention, but its complete inspected 17-page author manuscript treats general orbit enumeration and weak-coupling (\(a\le0.1\)) cycle expansions and does not supply this exact all-ring theorem. Dettmann (2002) is a plausible related source devoted to synchronized states; the abstract was available, but full text was not retrieved even after accessible preprint and lawful institutional attempts. The 2001 Chatterjee–Gupte paper presents a general reduced-matrix method, not the concrete checkerboard law. The distinction is established from statements and mathematical coverage rather than keyword mismatch. Search non-hits are not proof of absolute priority; unresolved historic literature remains a residual risk.

value.rationale: The source’s spatially synchronous temporal two-cycle vanishes by \(a=1/3\), making the persistence and sharp stability of a nonsynchronous travelling two-colour pattern for \(a>3/5\) a natural meaningful contrast. The result classifies its complete transverse Floquet spectrum for every even lattice size and in the infinite l2 setting, not just the 2-site invariant submanifold, and establishes a universal coupling \(a=4/5\) minimizing its asymptotic linear contraction factor. The exact cancellation across all spatial Fourier modes is structural and distinguishes stability of a coherent propagating pattern from elementary scalar dynamics. It neither claims global attraction nor genericity for arbitrary coupled maps.
